steps.title: Analyze Build Error
steps.description: Inspected the build log and found that the resource IDs (R.id.*) are non-constant expressions under AGP 8+, causing compiler errors in the switch-case statements.

steps.title: Refactor Button Click Handler
steps.description: Refactored the switch-case inside MainActivity's onClick() method into an if-else chain to handle non-constant resource IDs.

steps.title: Refactor Operator Logic
steps.description: Changed the String-based switch operator evaluation inside calculateResult() to use safe if-else equals statements for absolute reliability.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensured that only fully backward-compatible Java code structures are utilized, adhering strictly to standard object/method practices without lambdas or streams.

steps.title: Maintain Layout Compatibility
steps.description: Validated that all button references (btn0 to btn9, mathematical operators, clear, and equals) align with the corresponding IDs in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Review Manifest Directives
steps.description: Verified the AndroidManifest configuration remains fully compliant, featuring the absolute class name for MainActivity and exporting it appropriately.

steps.title: Verify App Settings and Meta Information
steps.description: Confirmed that the package namespace 'com.generatedappname.app' is consistently specified in app-meta.json and build.gradle.

steps.title: Verify No External Dependencies
steps.description: Confirmed that the local arithmetic execution runs independently on-device without reaching external endpoints.

steps.title: Verify Proguard and Build Environment
steps.description: Checked that compile and target SDK values are kept at version 34 to proceed with the modern runtime framework.

steps.title: Building Calculator
steps.description: Executed the Gradle build process to compile the fixed Java code and bundle it successfully into the debug APK.
